metadata.description: Community-driven collection of Claude Code skills, agents, and plugins for software development workflows

plugins.name: smart-commit
plugins.description: Intelligent git commit skill with Conventional Commits, automatic change decomposition into logical groups, and interactive approval workflow

plugins.name: module-docs-generator
plugins.description: Generate AGENTS.md, CONTRACTS.md, and INTEGRATIONS.md documentation for a module in a PHP modular monolith — domain, strategic and tactical design, published contracts, and consumed integrations

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent code review skill simulating JaziTheDev's review style — PR discipline, bugs and smells, project-rules compliance, historical context, code documentation, and tactical/strategic DDD. Posts findings as inline GitHub review comments. Invoked as /code-review:code-review.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview skill that relentlessly questions you about a plan or design — walking each branch of the decision tree one question at a time, with recommended answers — until you reach shared understanding. Adapted from Matt Pocock's skills collection.

plugins.name: karpathy-guidelines
plugins.description: Behavioral guidelines that reduce common LLM coding mistakes — surface assumptions, keep changes simple and surgical, and define verifiable success criteria. Derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls, packaged from the multica-ai skills collection.

plugins.name: create-jira-ticket
plugins.description: Create and update well-structured Jira tickets — Context, Expected Result, numbered full-sentence acceptance criteria, and optional Action Points, QA Notes and Implementation Plan sections. Keeps implementation detail out of the acceptance criteria, retires Action Points as they are answered, and updates existing tickets safely. Site- and project-agnostic; remembers your filing preferences and previews before writing.

plugins.name: create-gitlab-work-item
plugins.description: Create and update well-structured GitLab work items — Context, Expected Result, acceptance criteria, and optional Action Points, QA Notes and Implementation Plan sections. Keeps implementation detail out of the acceptance criteria, retires Action Points as they are answered, and updates existing items safely via the glab CLI.

plugins.name: pull-request
plugins.description: Create draft pull requests from the commits on the current branch — a single PR, or a stacked chain of child PRs under a collective branch — list the GitHub pull requests awaiting your code review, and board the open PRs you authored with their review, checks, merge state and stack topology. Provider-agnostic creation: full GitHub and GitLab support, honest fallback elsewhere; always previews the full PR plan before creating anything.
